note: Our own list: Google Fonts alternatives for common system and commercial fonts. Metric-compatible clones come first where one exists. Names are matched case-insensitively; a test checks every alternative is in the catalog.

fonts.name: Arial
fonts.why: Arimo is metric-compatible with Arial: same widths, so text reflows identically.

fonts.name: Helvetica
fonts.why: Neo-grotesque sans serifs with the same calm, closed shapes.

fonts.name: Helvetica Neue
fonts.why: Neo-grotesque sans serifs with the same calm, closed shapes.

fonts.name: Segoe UI
fonts.why: Open humanist sans serifs built for screens, like Segoe.

fonts.name: Segoe UI Variable
fonts.why: Open humanist sans serifs built for screens, like Segoe.

fonts.name: Verdana
fonts.why: Wide, open sans serifs with large x-heights for small sizes.

fonts.name: Tahoma
fonts.why: Compact humanist sans serifs close to Tahoma's narrow Verdana shapes.

fonts.name: Trebuchet MS
fonts.why: Humanist sans serifs with some of Trebuchet's lively details.

fonts.name: Calibri
fonts.why: Carlito is metric-compatible with Calibri; Lato shares its soft, rounded feel.

fonts.name: Aptos
fonts.why: Clean grotesque sans serifs with the even rhythm of Aptos.

fonts.name: Cambria
fonts.why: Caladea is metric-compatible with Cambria.

fonts.name: Georgia
fonts.why: Gelasio is metric-compatible with Georgia.

fonts.name: Times New Roman
fonts.why: Tinos is metric-compatible with Times New Roman.

fonts.name: Times
fonts.why: Tinos is metric-compatible with Times.

fonts.name: Garamond
fonts.why: Revivals of Claude Garamond's types.

fonts.name: Baskerville
fonts.why: A Baskerville revival tuned for screens.

fonts.name: Bodoni

fonts.name: Courier New

fonts.why: Typewriter monospace faces.
